# Plasma cell and Adipocyte spatial signal maps

#===================================================================
# SCOPE NOTE: this script deliberately covers ONLY the two spatial
# signal maps below (plasma cell RCTD signal, adipocyte NMF signal).
# The DRAXIN/Schwann-program analysis these were originally embedded
# in (08_Draxin_DE_analysis) is NOT going into the paper in its current
# form and is intentionally left uncleaned in a trials/ folder -- only
# the two plots that ARE being kept were extracted and cleaned here.
#
# BUGFIXES (this pass, from the original plasma cell script):
#   - `W_nerve` was referenced but never defined anywhere in that
#     script (undefined variable) -- should have been `W_df`.
#   - The plasma cell column name appeared in three different WRONG
#     spellings across that script (`B_cells_(Plasma cells)` with a
#     space, `B_cells(Plasma cells)` missing an underscore) -- the
#     actual column name, per RCTD_compute_cleaned.Rmd's renaming, is
#     `B_cells_(Plasma_cells)` (underscores throughout). Fixed to use
#     the correct name consistently.
#
# THIS SCRIPT ONLY GENERATES FIGURES -- reads RCTD_weights.Rds and the
# frozen nerve identification columns; never recomputes either. Safe
# to re-run as often as needed.
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
# --------------------------
# Figures (output/13_plasma_and_adipocyte_signal/figures/):
#   - FigureS7A_plasma_weight_rctd_with_nerve_borders.pdf
#       Figure S7A. Continuous RCTD plasma-cell weight, with nerve hull
#       outlines coloured by invasion status. A simple categorical
#       version of the same map (Plasma-High vs Plasma-Low per spot)
#       also existed; only this continuous version is kept.
#   - FigureS6A_adipocyte_signal.png
#       Figure S6A. Continuous adipocyte NMF programme signal, same
#       nerve hull overlay style, clipped at the 1st/99th percentile
#       for contrast.
#===================================================================

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=14))

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "06_plasma_and_adipocyte_signal"
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

c25 <- c(
  "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", "green4", "#6A3D9A", "#FF7F00",
  "black", "gold1", "skyblue2", "#FB9A99", "palegreen2",
  "#CAB2D6", "#FDBF6F", "gray70", "khaki2",
  "maroon", "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4",
  "darkturquoise", "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3",
  "darkorange4", "brown"
)

# ---- Frozen inputs: never recomputed here ------------------------------
spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "DE_SPE_annotaion.csv")))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode

W_df <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "RCTD_weights.Rds"))

# Adipocyte NMF signal
comp <- as.matrix(t(reducedDims(spe)[["compk30"]]))
spe$adipocytes <- comp["Adipocytes", ]

sample_order <- c(
  "54703bl38_noPNI", "6249bl23_noPNI", "70865bl5_noPNI",
  "54703bl28_highPNI", "6249bl18_noPNIandhighPNI", "70865bl15_highPNI"
)
label_map <- c(
  "54703bl38_noPNI" = "P1-Adjacent", "6249bl23_noPNI" = "P2-Adjacent",
  "70865bl5_noPNI" = "P3-Adjacent", "54703bl28_highPNI" = "P1-Diseased",
  "6249bl18_noPNIandhighPNI" = "P2-Diseased", "70865bl15_highPNI" = "P3-Diseased"
)
colData(spe)$sample_id <- factor(as.character(colData(spe)$sample_id), levels = sample_order)
```

## Nerve hulls (shared by plasma and adipocyte detail maps below)

```{r}
make_nerve_hulls <- function(dat) {
  dat %>%
    group_by(sample_id, NerveID, Invaded) %>%
    filter(n() >= 3) %>%
    slice(chull(x, y)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(group_id = interaction(sample_id, NerveID, drop = TRUE))
}

nerve_all <- as.data.frame(colData(spe)) %>%
  filter(is.nerve == TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    x = as.numeric(array_col),
    y = -as.numeric(array_row),
    sample_id = factor(as.character(sample_id), levels = sample_order),
    NerveID = as.character(NerveID),
    Invaded = as.character(Invaded)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y), !is.na(sample_id), !is.na(NerveID), !is.na(Invaded))

hulls_all <- make_nerve_hulls(nerve_all)
hulls_inv <- hulls_all %>% filter(Invaded == "Invaded")
hulls_non <- hulls_all %>% filter(Invaded == "NonInvaded")
```

## Plasma cell signal -- continuous RCTD weight with nerve hull outlines (Figure S7A)

```{r}
df_spots <- as.data.frame(colData(spe)) %>%
  mutate(barcode = colnames(spe), x = array_col, y = -array_row) %>%
  # BUGFIX: correct column name (see header note)
  left_join(W_df %>% transmute(barcode, plasma_weight_rctd = `B_cells_(Plasma_cells)`), by = "barcode")

clip_q <- c(0.01, 0.99)
q_plasma <- quantile(df_spots$plasma_weight_rctd, probs = clip_q, na.rm = TRUE)
df_spots <- df_spots %>%
  mutate(plasma_for_plot = pmin(pmax(plasma_weight_rctd, q_plasma[1]), q_plasma[2]))

p_plasma_hulls <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_spots, aes(x = x, y = y, color = plasma_for_plot), size = 0.4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Plasma cell weight (RCTD)", option = "A", na.value = "grey85",
                        limits = c(q_plasma[1], q_plasma[2]), oob = scales::squish) +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls_non, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group_id),
              fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3, color = "white") +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls_inv, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group_id),
              fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3, color = "white") +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls_non, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group_id, linetype = "Uninvaded"),
              fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7, color = "skyblue2") +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls_inv, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group_id, linetype = "Invaded"),
              fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7, color = "#E31A1C") +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Nerve border", values = c("Uninvaded" = "solid", "Invaded" = "solid")) +
  facet_wrap(~sample_id, labeller = as_labeller(label_map)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void()

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS7A_plasma_weight_rctd_with_nerve_borders.pdf"), p_plasma_hulls,
      width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 1200)
p_plasma_hulls
```

## Adipocyte signal (NMF) with nerve hull outlines -- Figure S6A

```{r}
adipo_df <- as.data.frame(colData(spe)) %>%
  transmute(
    x = as.numeric(array_col), y = -as.numeric(array_row),
    adipocytes = as.numeric(adipocytes),
    sample_id = factor(as.character(sample_id), levels = sample_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y), is.finite(adipocytes), !is.na(sample_id))

q_adipo <- quantile(adipo_df$adipocytes, probs = clip_q, na.rm = TRUE)
adipo_df <- adipo_df %>% mutate(adipo_plot = pmin(pmax(adipocytes, q_adipo[1]), q_adipo[2]))

p_adipo_spatial_hulls <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = adipo_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = adipo_plot),
            pch = 21, size = 0.9, color = "transparent", stroke = 0, alpha = 1) +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls_non, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group_id),
              fill = NA, linewidth = 0, color = "white") +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls_inv, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group_id),
              fill = NA, linewidth = 0, color = "white") +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls_non, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group_id, linetype = "Non-invaded"),
              fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2, color = "skyblue2") +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls_inv, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group_id, linetype = "Invaded"),
              fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2, color = "khaki2") +
  facet_wrap(~sample_id, labeller = as_labeller(label_map)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "A", name = "Adipocyte signal",
                       limits = c(q_adipo[1], q_adipo[2]), oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Nerve border", values = c("Invaded" = "solid", "Non-invaded" = "solid")) +
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2))) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS6A_adipocyte_signal.png"), p_adipo_spatial_hulls,
      width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
p_adipo_spatial_hulls
```
